title: Professional Certificate Course in Managerial Economics and Demand Analysis
description: The course aims to provide businesses with the tools and techniques to make informed pricing, production, and resource allocation decisions.
longDescription: Understand the Nature and Scope of Managerial Economics. Understand Optimization Techniques and New Management Tools. Understand Demand Theory and Price Elasticity of Demand. Understand Demand Estimation & Demand Forecasting. The aim of the "Managerial Economics and Demand Analys" course is to provide businesses with the tools and techniques to make informed decisions about pricing, production, and resource allocation. After the successful completion of this lecture, you will be able to:
courseDetails: Managerial Economics applies economic theory and quantitative methods to solve business problems and optimize decision-making. Demand Analysis and Estimation, in particular, help businesses understand the behaviour of consumers in relation to their products or services. By analyzing consumer demand, businesses can determine the optimal pricing strategy and how to allocate resources to maximize profits.
